title.correction: BoomTile/Megaboom: 20k routing congestion DRCs observed at 0.24 placement density

prior_state.issue: 'Failed GRT' is ambiguous; does not specify failure mode (e.g., non-convergence, DRC violations, or timing).
prior_state.correction: GRT failed to complete due to 20k routing congestion DRCs.

observation.issue: Congestion heatmap claim lacks verifiable evidence (e.g., screenshot, log, or data).
observation.correction: Congestion heatmap (not attached in record) reportedly showed a large region at the top of the die and around the macro.

hypothesis.issue_1: 'Too aggressive' for routing-layer adjustment (0.45) is undefined and lacks justification.
hypothesis.correction: The GRT routing-layer adjustment of 0.45 (which increases estimated routing capacity) may be too high for this design, leading to overestimation of available routing resources and subsequent congestion.

critique.issue_2: Global-route path 'looping around the macro' is speculative and unverified in this record.
critique.correction: A separate suspected cause, reported in issue #5971, is a global-route path looping around the macro many times (unverified in this record).

candidates_considered.issue: Lacks justification for why candidates were expected to resolve the issue and omits other potential candidates (e.g., routing priorities, design constraints).
candidates_considered.correction: Increasing congestion iterations (default 30) to allow more time for routing optimization; reducing routing layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 to avoid overestimating routing capacity; macro-placement improvements (tracked in issue #5971) to reduce congestion around macros; adjusting routing priorities or design constraints (not explored in this thread).

chosen_intervention.issue_1: 'Finish GRT' and 'complete BoomTile' are undefined (e.g., no DRCs, no timing violations, or successful routing stage completion).
chosen_intervention.correction: GRT was reported to complete with 0 DRCs.

issue_2: Does not specify whether changes were applied in isolation or concurrently with other adjustments.
correction: Reduced the routing layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 and increased congestion iterations to 35. No other changes were reported in this thread.

post_state.issue: Lacks measurable outcomes (e.g., DRC count, runtime) to verify resolution.
post_state.correction: GRT was reported to complete with 0 DRCs (no post-fix DRC count or runtime was provided in the thread).

gaps.issue: Does not address lack of clarity in hypothesis or speculative nature of macro-loop root cause.
correction: No measured post-fix DRC count or runtime is reported.
